get_transcript.name: get_transcript
get_transcript.description: Fetches transcript of a YouTube video.

text.description: If true, the transcript will be merged into a single text instead of timestamped chunks.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the transcript/captions of a YouTube video from its URL via the Gistly API. Use this to get the spoken text of a video for summarizing, searching, or analysis. Set the Merge Text option to return one continuous text block, or leave it off to get timestamped chunks. Read-only and idempotent — fetching the same URL returns the same transcript.

nl.If true, the transcript will be merged i: Als het waar is, zal het transcript worden samengevoegd tot één tekst in plaats van getimestreerde chunks.
